name: paypal
title: PayPal
summary: OAuth 2.0 client-credentials tokens, Orders v2 (create, confirm, authorize, capture) and Payments v2 refunds, with order and capture webhooks and instrument-declined, rate-limit and outage scenarios.

upstream.notes: Only the Orders v2 spec is pinned (one upstream file per example); Payments v2 is openapi/payments_payment_v2.json in the same repository and keeps its operation ids in paypal-payments.openapi.yaml. PayPal publishes no OpenAPI file for /v1/oauth2/token. The upstream Orders spec declares no 429 and no webhooks, and its loose id patterns (^[\S\s]*$) make offline answers unreadable; it is best used with an LLM. Real webhooks are verified with PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-SIG (certificate signature over transmission id, time, webhook id and the body's CRC32), which Mockingbird does not produce; the example signs with hmac-sha256 instead.
